name: Papa John's
disclaimer_extra: Papa John's publishes every topping per slice, for each crust and size. Build the pizza, then choose how many slices you ate. Per-slice values are rounded by Papa John's, so a whole pizza carries that rounding multiplied by the slice count. Topping values are published for a one-topping pizza; a heavily loaded pizza may differ.
blurb: Build a Papa John's pizza slice by slice — crust, size, sauce, cheese and every topping, with per-slice figures for each crust and size.

components.name: Epic Stuffed Crust (Large)
components.derived: Papa John's sells Epic Stuffed Crust on custom pizzas but publishes no crust row for it. These figures are the Original Crust Large row plus the difference between Papa John's own Large and Epic Stuffed Cheese Pizza (290 vs 360 cal per slice), which is the crust swap with sauce and cheese held constant. Epic Stuffed is Large-only, so every sauce, cheese and topping below is Papa John's published Large figure.
